suite: AetherWeave Frontend Visual & DOM Synchronization Verification

test_scenarios.title: DOM React State Synchronization Post 5000ms Delayed Webhook
test_scenarios.description: Validates that when a delayed webhook is ingested and later dispatched, client-side SWR/polling hooks refresh the Event Timeline, updating the status badge from pending to success without missed React onChange or stale closure desynchronization.

test_scenarios.title: Interactive Chaos Configuration Panel Real-time Mutation
test_scenarios.description: Asserts that adjusting the Latency Slider (ms) and Drop Probability Slider (%) dynamically mutates the active endpoint chaos profile, persists via PATCH /api/endpoints/[id], and immediately updates the Visual Flow Map circuit topology.
